text: **MODE A - SOLUTION** Root cause: The customer wants to write verbose gc output to a log file other than native_stdout. Resolution steps: Technote used

MODE A - SOLUTION Root cause summary: The error "Error: Java was started but returned exit code = -1" when launching Rational Software Architect (RSA) application is caused by the lack of declaration of required capabilities in the info.plist file. Resolution steps: Technote ID(s)
Identify your Java home by executing `/usr/libexec/java_home` and note the path, for example `/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk1.8.0_121.jdk/Contents/Home`
Change the directory to `/Contents/` where there is a file named `Info.plist`
Open the `Info.plist` file for editing and locate the `<dict>` section with key `JVMCapabilities`
Add the following `<string>` elements: `<dict><key>JVMCapabilities</key><array><string>CommandLine</string><string>JNI</string><string>BundledApp</string></array></dict>`
Save the `Info.plist` file and launch RSA

MODE A - SOLUTION Root cause summary: The system has a large number of ghost queues that have taken up most of the file system space. Resolution steps: Technote IDs used: , [nas8N1019124], , [nas8N1021607]

Delete and redefine the model queues to delete the associated pool of "ghost" queues. Start the QMgr using `strmqm QMgrName`, save the definitions of the user-defined model queues using `runmqsc` with `display qmodel(*)`, identify the user-defined queues, and save their definition either manually or by using "saveqmgr" from the SupportPac MS03

Do not delete any files or members in the QSPL library to free up DASD, as this can result in spooled files being deleted without control over which ones are deleted [nas8N1019124]. Instead, use the metaphor of a library and remove some bookcases (spooling database files) without taking out the appropriate cards from the card catalog
Disable STATQ for dynamic queues via the associated model queues to prevent a large number of ghost queues from being created

Use the `PRTDSKINF` command with `RPTTYPE(*SYS)` to obtain a disk report and review the resulting QPEZDISK spooled file output to determine which user directories are using the most space in the IFS. Then, use the `RTVDIRINF` command to retrieve directory information about the root and all nested subdirectories and store it in the database files MYROOTDIRO and MYROOTDIRD in library QUSRSYS [nas8N1021607]

MODE A - SOLUTION Root cause summary: The system has a large number of ghost queues that have taken up most of the file system space. Resolution steps: Technote IDs used: , [nas8N1019124], , [nas8N1021607]

Delete and redefine the model queues to delete the associated pool of "ghost" queues. Start the QMgr using `strmqm QMgrName`, save the definitions of the user-defined model queues using `runmqsc` with `display qmodel(*)`, identify the user-defined queues, and save their definition either manually or by using "saveqmgr" from the SupportPac MS03

Do not delete any files or members in the QSPL library to free up DASD, as this can result in spooled files being deleted without control over which ones are deleted [nas8N1019124]. Instead, use the metaphor of a library and remove some bookcases (spooling database files) without taking out the appropriate cards from the card catalog
Disable STATQ for dynamic queues via the associated model queues to prevent a large number of ghost queues from being created

Use the `PRTDSKINF` command with `RPTTYPE(*SYS)` to obtain a disk report and review the resulting QPEZDISK spooled file output to determine which user directories are using the most space in the IFS. Then, use the `RTVDIRINF` command to retrieve directory information about the root and all nested subdirectories and store it in the database files MYROOTDIRO and MYROOTDIRD in library QUSRSYS [nas8N1021607]

MODE A - SOLUTION Root cause: The AUTOMATIC value for NUM_IOSERVERS is changed after applying 10.5FP7. Resolution steps: Technote ID(s)
Refer to Technote  which explains that the formula for calculating the number of prefetchers has been changed in 10.5FP7, resulting in a lower default value for AUTOMATIC
The new formula is: `number of prefetchers = max( max( max over all table spaces( parallelism setting ), number of cores * number of SMT threads ), 12 )`
This change affects the behavior of NUM_IOSERVERS=AUTOMATIC, which may be too low for large systems with high workload

MODE A - SOLUTION Root cause summary: The system has a large number of ghost queues that have taken up most of the file system space. Resolution steps: Technote IDs used: , [nas8N1019124], , [nas8N1021607]

Delete and redefine the model queues to delete the associated pool of "ghost" queues. Start the QMgr using `strmqm QMgrName`, save the definitions of the user-defined model queues using `runmqsc` with `display qmodel(*)`, identify the user-defined queues, and save their definition either manually or by using "saveqmgr" from the SupportPac MS03

Do not delete any files or members in the QSPL library to free up DASD, as this can result in spooled files being deleted without control over which ones are deleted [nas8N1019124]. Instead, use the metaphor of a library and remove some bookcases (spooling database files) without taking out the appropriate cards from the card catalog
Disable STATQ for dynamic queues via the associated model queues to prevent a large number of ghost queues from being created

Use the `PRTDSKINF` command with `RPTTYPE(*SYS)` to obtain a disk report and review the resulting QPEZDISK spooled file output to determine which user directories are using the most space in the IFS. Then, use the `RTVDIRINF` command to retrieve directory information about the root and all nested subdirectories and store it in the database files MYROOTDIRO and MYROOTDIRD in library QUSRSYS [nas8N1021607]

Root cause: Restriction in remote login using ssh. Resolution steps: Technote
Review the file /etc/ssh/sshd_config on the specific server using console
Make sure PermitRootLogin is set to yes
Save the change in the file
Restart the appliance
Root cause: WebSphere MQ is unable to convert string data due to a DBCS error. Resolution steps: Technote
Check the WebSphere MQ Application Programming Reference Appendix and the appropriate National Language Support publications to see if the CCSIDs  are supported by your system
Root cause: Traces can be set in three ways. Resolution steps: Technote
Check if DEBUG setting along with each entry in the node table is something like a typical trace of 8C00006E
If the DEBUG setting displayed is different from the Init Parm, then a user has changed the value dynamically only for the duration of the started task
Review if that is still necessary and turn it off as needed using ADMIN;MD screen
Determine which user set traces on by looking for messages STRA047I or STRA048I
Root cause: The Netcool/OMNIbus V8.1 version of this gateway supports the following Operating Systems: AIX, Linux, Solaris, Windows and zLinux. Resolution steps: Technote
If you are running Netcool/OMNIbus V8.1, a single package contains versions of the gateway for all supported Operating Systems
To obtain this new package, use the Find by part number field to search for part number: CN6I1EN
Root cause: CVE-2017-12150, CVE-2017-12151, and CVE-2017-12163 are security vulnerabilities in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Server 6.2. Resolution steps: Technote
Contact Red Hat to obtain and install fixes for Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Server 6.2, as applicable
Root cause: A message-driven bean (MDB) running on a WebSphere Application Server 7 is configured to use the WebSphere MQ messaging provider. Resolution steps: Technote
Delete messages from the WMQ queue and restart the WAS application

Root cause: The underlying network connection for a data source is no longer valid although the data source itself remains considered active from the WebSphere Application Server data source connection pool management perspective. Resolution steps: Technote
Configure your database to not timeout connections after a period of inactivity
Root cause: Some new instances get created against the old snapshot after migrating to a new snapshot. Resolution steps: Technote
Use the MoveToken REST API command
Root cause: Apache Commons FileUpload, as used in certain products, could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system. Resolution steps: Technote
Apply fixes for both IBM Business Process Manager and WebSphere Enterprise Service Bus
Root cause: The error occurs due to a mismatched variable type. Resolution steps: Technote
Check if there are any primitive data type mismatches in your process application
Root cause: The var/sa/dialogue directory fills up with entries due to failed plugin steps when agents do not send an acknowledgement within a specified time frame. Resolution steps: Technote
Make sure there are no processes or version imports running
Stop the server
Delete all entries in the var/sa/dialogues directory
Start the server
Root cause: You want to create batches of image or pdf files from documents shared at one location. Resolution steps: Technote
Create a new VScan Ruleset with a unique name and have action SetSourceDirectory point to a new directory

Create a new Task Profile by going to the Task Profiles Tab and selecting New --> Custom --> Unique Name, add the new Ruleset to the profile, and add the Rule which is located under the Ruleset from step 1 to the Document hierarchy (DCO) under Batch --> Open
In TMWeb, add the workflow and tasks with descriptive names for ingestion location, add all other tasks, and name the task the same as in the Studio task profile from step2
In the Application Manager Rulerunner tab, add the new task profile name from step2
Root cause: It is an known current limitation of DB2. Resolution steps: Technote
Delete and recreate the WebSphere Application Server data source to switch to the regular DB2 Universal JDBC driver provider
Update the InfoSphere Warehouse metadata tables to indicate that the data source uses the normal DB2 connection and not the XA provider
Root cause: There is not enough space available on the WebSphere DataPower appliance to complete the upgrade. Resolution steps: Technote
Review the Upgrade and Rollback Guide, Generation 2 Firmware sections on removing extraneous files
Root cause: Persistence between chained services can cause repeated retries. Resolution steps: Technote
Set "Persistent Connections" radio button (on the PMGW Advanced tab) to off
Root cause: One of the required fields in the configuration does not have a value. Resolution steps: Technote
Make sure all required fields on General, Repositories, Layout, and Menus tabs have a value
Root cause: Memory allocated was not the supported number. Resolution steps: Technote
Login to the Dataserver
Click on Administration > Dashboard tab and review the Application status to make sure it is green
Click on Controller Link, review and confirm that all services are running fine, and if needed, make changes to memory
Root cause: OpenSSL could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by an error in the DES/3DES cipher, used as a part of the SSL/TLS protocol. Resolution steps: Technote
The affected CipherSpecs are TRIPLE_DES_SHA_US, FIPS_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA, ECDHE_ECDSA_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA256, and ECDHE_RSA_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA256
Root cause: The database will reuse all free and available space before starting to increase its size. Resolution steps: Technote
If Automatic Storage is enabled, there is no method to reduce the size of the tablespace already allocated to a database
Root cause: The menu AlertsMenu has a tool in it called CLEAR_LWY, however the tool no longer exists. Resolution steps: Technote
Recreate the tool and associate it with the menu
Root cause: The XML toolkit xml4c library directory is missing from LIBPATH environment variable. Resolution steps: Technote
Add the XML toolkit xml4c library directory to the LIBPATH environment variable
Root cause: The profile path must not exist. Resolution steps: Technote
Use a non-existing profile path with the BPMConfig command if you want to set a custom directory for the profile data
Root cause: The SSLv3 protocol is not supported by default in CMAC. Resolution steps: Technote
Upgrade and configure your browser to make sure SSLv3 is disabled
Root cause: The '<userId>' unique name is not valid. Resolution steps: Technote
Configure sso_<n>.sp.idMap to use "dn" instead of "idAssertion"
Root cause: The application status is "Unknown" because it has not been discovered and enabled for monitoring. Resolution steps: Technote
Check in the Application Configuration workspace to see if the status of the application is set to "Enabled"
Associate the WasAppDiscovered situation with the Application Health navigator item
Run the Take Action Set_Application_Monitoring on specific applications that are presented with a status of disabled or discovered

Root cause: If operating system and database codepage both are UTF-8, but the data to be inserted is not Unicode, then data in the database might have incorrect codepoints (not-Unicode). Resolution steps: Technote
Remove special character from comment
Follow procedure from DB2 Technote number: 1412846
Root cause: The DB2 Data Server Driver for JDBC and SQLJ is responsible for creating these files in /tmp. Resolution steps: Technote
license.lock - Used to indicate that 'connlicj.bin' is being updated
connlicj.bin - Cached License verification information
jccdiag.log - License diagnostic information
serverlist.lock - List of Servers (zOS)
jccServerListCache.bin - Automatic Client Reroute server list
Root cause: The format of a text file is lost when it is attached to a file component and is referenced in a content page due to the mime type not being set. Resolution steps: Technote
Find the "# Mapping of mimetypes to extensions" section
At the end of "mimetype.list=", put following: ,extensiontype.txt
Put following after "extensiontype.lzh=application/octet-stream": extensiontype.txt=text/plain
Restart the server, make sure to remove all the browser cache at this stage
Root cause: The trial license is copied to the local hard drive as part of the IBM SPSS Modeler installation. Resolution steps: Technote
Please ensure that you don't have any open windows of IBM SPSS Modeler running
Restart the License Authorization Wizard as an Administrator and select the Enable Trial option

You would now need to point to the location of the trial licence file (located in the installation directory of the Demo version of Modeler), do this by clicking on the ‘Open Folder’ icon and selecting the ‘temp.txt’ file
Complete the rest of the wizard and restart IBM SPSS Modeler, you should now be able to use the application for 14 days
Root cause: The X11 font fileset is not installed or is missing some packages. Resolution steps: Technote
Ask the AIX system administrator to check that the X11 font filesets in the list below are installed
Root cause: Multiple vulnerabilities have been identified in WebSphere Application Server shipped with WebSphere Service Registry and Repository. Resolution steps: Technote
Please consult the security bulletin WebSphere Application Server [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid= for vulnerability details and information about fixes

Root cause: Authenticated user does not have the attribute defined in the backend user registry which matches the attribute defined in the store.puma_default.user.fbadefault.filter property in WP PumaStoreService Resource Environment Provider. Resolution steps: Technote
Collect LDIF export of a sample user that hits this problem (if the backend user registry is LDAP)
Root cause: There are multiple vulnerabilities in IBM Runtime Environment Java used by API Connect. Resolution steps: Technote
Download and replace AppScan's Java directory
Root cause: The page having the issue does not have a CCO file in the batch folder. Resolution steps: Technote
Verify that each page displayed to a Verify user has a CCO file (a page data file)
Root cause: The On Demand Router (ODR) has a memory leak related to HttpRouteAction objects. Resolution steps: Technote
Restart the ODR
Root cause: The Document Class Property was inherited from a parent Document Class. Resolution steps: Technote
Make the desired changes in the Document Class where the property is defined and then propagate the change to the classes that inherit the property
Root cause: The EJB specification defines the meaning of these two exceptions when the invocation of an SFSB causes either of these exceptions to be thrown. Resolution steps: Technote
Determine if the SFSB instance has timed out
Determine if the bean was removed
Root cause: Completed business process definition instances are not deleted from the system automatically. Resolution steps: Technote
Use stored procedure LSW_BPD_INSTANCE_DELETE
Use wsadmin command BPMProcessInstanceCleanup  (v8.0 and later)
Use process inspector (web based or process designer client)
Root cause: Recent Java updates have caused connection problems when logging into the TEPS via the TEP client (Browser or Java Web Start). Resolution steps: Technote
Check if port 15200 is in LISTENING on the TEPS server
If port 15200 is not listening, check if IHS is running and start it if necessary
If port 15200 is listening, check for firewall rules preventing communication with port 15200
If firewall rules are present, disable them or configure the TEPS to use a different port
Root cause: IBM has not tested or sought certification with Citrix, and does not provide support for Citrix. Resolution steps: Technote
Some customers successfully operate Datacap thick clients in remote sites using Citrix or other remote access technology
If you deploy Datacap clients on Citrix and encounter issues, IBM might require you to reproduce the issues outside of Citrix as part of the investigation
Root cause: During the upgrade from Cognos BI 10.x.x to Cognos Analytics 11.0.x, the location of images changed for legacy studios. Resolution steps: Technote
Copying the <COGNOS_INSTALL>/webcontent/explore folder to <COGNOS_INSTALL>/webcontent/bi will allow the images to be displayed correctly
Root cause: Java 6 on WebSphere Application Server V8.5 reaches end of service (EOS) in April 2018. Resolution steps: Technote
Use Java 7 or Java 8 instead of Java 6
Upgrade to IBM Business Process Manager (BPM) V8.5.7 and IBM Business Monitor V8.5.7 if Java 7 is not supported on your current version, or upgrade to IBM BPM V8.6 if Java 8 is not supported
Root cause: OpenSSL could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by an error while parsing an IPAddressFamily extension in an X.509 certificate. Resolution steps: Technote
For MQ 5.3, apply fix 5.3.1.14
For MQ 8, apply fix 8.0.0.4 or later
Root cause: You would like to know what documentation you must collect (MustGather) so that the IBM Business Process Manager Support team can diagnose your problem. Resolution steps: Technote
Gather general diagnostic information
As needed, gather process Designer tracing, SSL tracing, Javacores and garbage collection (GC) logging for hangs, performance, and memory issues
Root cause: Failed resources are found when checking the cluster status using crm_mon. Resolution steps: Technote
Use cib_tool.pl to clear each failed resource
Root cause: The Netcool/OMNIbus Java Gateway for ServiceNow will be ready for downloading on November 24, 2016. Resolution steps: Technote
You can download the installation package from the IBM Passport Advantage website
You can access the latest version of the guide written for this gateway on the IBM Knowledge Center

Add the server certificate to the Eclipse JVM truststore using the keytool -import command

Run the License Authorization Wizard and request a license using the Authorization Code (AC) that came with your software

Root cause: Node.js is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by an uncaught exception flaw in the zlib module. Resolution steps: Technote
Apply PTF  for releases 7.1, 7.2 and 7.3 of IBM i

Update the wimconfig.xml file as follows and restart the application server: <config:baseEntries name="dc=ibm,dc=com" nameInRepository="dc=ibm,dc=com" />
Root cause: This issue is generally due to an important workload increase. Resolution steps: Technote
Increase the value of LOCKTIMEOUT parameter using benchmarking techniques to tune this parameter
Root cause: The default behavior of DataPower firmware 4.0.0 has changed to reject connections with insecure servers. Resolution steps: Technote

Root cause: The Data Collector (DC) connection may fail with “Connection Refused” if the Managing Server’s(MS) host name can resolve to an IP address that cannot reach the MS. Resolution steps: Technote
Instead of host name, specify a “valid” IP address for the MS in the <MS_HOME>/bin/setenv.sh file, and in ITCAM 6.1, the ms.properties file

Change as directed: ITCAM 6.0 ( or earlier ) In MS_home/bin/setenv.sh: KERNEL_HOST01=<ip addr of MS> KERNEL_HOST02=<ip addr of MS>  ITCAM 6.1 In MS_home/bin setenv.sh: am_socket_bindip=<ip addr of MS> am_socket_exportip=<ip addr of MS> In MS_HOME/etc/ms.properties, modify “kernel.hosts” specifying MS IP address: kernel.hosts=<ip addr of MS>CBSPort:RFSPort:RMIPort - usually - kernel.hosts=<ip addr of MS>9122:9120:9118

Re-create or repair the MRC file and retry the operation
Root cause: The PureApplication System may not be healthy due to various reasons. Resolution steps: Technote
Use the System Health check report to see a consolidated view of some of the PureApplication System UI pages
Review the Lite Health Checks section, which lists a set of items you can review every couple of days
Review the Full Health Checks section, which lists a set of items you can review every week to help confirm your system is operational

Download all of the parts that you need, both required and optional

Root cause: The configuration settings for Call Home are not configured properly. Resolution steps: Technote

Click on the edit button next to Connection, copy and paste the current proxy information (IP and port), select to connect to the internet directly, click Save, click the edit button next to Connection again, select to connect to IBM via HTTP proxy and input the IP address and port that you saved if they aren't already there, check global config again to make sure "CONNECTION_TYPE_1": 1 or 2, SSH to the floating PSM IP address with a local (non-LDAP) administrative account, run "psm reset Service53", and check High Availability status from the PureApp UI or by running "psm info all"
Root cause: The customer is experiencing performance degradation, hang, no response, hung threads, CPU starvation, high CPU utilization, network delays, or deadlocks. Resolution steps: Technote

Root cause: The formula for calculating the number of prefetchers to start at database activation time was changed from 10.5FP6 to 10.5FP7. Resolution steps: Technote
Until 10.5FP6, we use following fomula: number of prefetchers = max( max( max over all table spaces( parallelism setting ), number of cores * number of SMT threads ), 16 )
Starting from 10.5FP7, we use following fomula: number of prefetchers = max( max( max over all table spaces( parallelism setting ), number of cores * number of SMT threads ), 12 )

Root cause: Java 6 on WebSphere Application Server V8.5 reaches end of service (EOS) in April 2018. Resolution steps: Technote
Use Java 7 or Java 8 instead

Root cause: The formula for calculating the number of prefetchers to start at database activation time was changed from 10.5FP6 to 10.5FP7. Resolution steps: Technote
Until 10.5FP6, we use following fomula: number of prefetchers = max( max( max over all table spaces( parallelism setting ), number of cores * number of SMT threads ), 16 )
Starting from 10.5FP7, we use following fomula: number of prefetchers = max( max( max over all table spaces( parallelism setting ), number of cores * number of SMT threads ), 12 )
Root cause: The PureApplication System may not be healthy due to various reasons. Resolution steps: Technote
Use the System Health check report to see a consolidated view of some of the PureApplication System UI pages
Review the Lite Health Checks section, which lists a set of items you can review every couple of days
Review the Full Health Checks section, which lists a set of items you can review every week to help confirm your system is operational
Root cause: Corruption of the existing DataType has occurred (potentially as a result of an ungracious shutdown during editing). Resolution steps: Technote
Examine the .type file of the DataType in question for any missing properties or values or incomplete lines

If port 15200 is not listening, check if IHS is running and start it if necessary

Root cause: The configuration settings for Call Home are not configured properly. Resolution steps: Technote
In the PureApplication System Console navigate to System > Settings and then open the Service and Support Manager section

Click on the edit button next to Connection, copy and paste the current proxy information (IP and port), select to connect to the internet directly, click Save, click the edit button next to Connection again, select to connect to IBM via HTTP proxy and input the IP address and port that you saved if they aren't already there, check global config again to make sure "CONNECTION_TYPE_1": 1 or 2, SSH to the floating PSM IP address with a local (non-LDAP) administrative account, run "psm reset Service53", and check High Availability status from the PureApp UI or by running "psm info all"

Root cause: The TODAY function in Impromptu is not dynamic when saved as an IQD file. Resolution steps: Technote

Root cause: The formula for calculating the number of prefetchers to start at database activation time was changed from 10.5FP6 to 10.5FP7. Resolution steps: Technote
Until 10.5FP6, we use following fomula: number of prefetchers = max( max( max over all table spaces( parallelism setting ), number of cores * number of SMT threads ), 16 )
Starting from 10.5FP7, we use following fomula: number of prefetchers = max( max( max over all table spaces( parallelism setting ), number of cores * number of SMT threads ), 12 )
